Winneradspy is an ad intelligence tool built specifically for mobile apps and games. It tracks competitor ad creatives in real time, scores each one Winner or Loser using AI, and gives you a detailed breakdown of why each creative performs the way it does, covering hook, visuals, emotions, messaging, and CTA.

It analyzes signals including ad runtime, platform reach, creative reuse patterns, and engagement indicators to determine whether a competitor's mobile app ads are actively scaling or have already been dropped.

The platform tracks ad creatives running on Facebook, Instagram, and the wider Meta ad network, covering mobile app and mobile game campaigns worldwide. [...] Search any mobile app or game. See their winning ad creatives. Understand why they work. Build better campaigns.
